info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Contribution Reviews API
info.description: The Business Contribution Reviews API enables businesses to submit and manage reviews related to their contribution analysis findings. This endpoint allows stakeholders to enhance their banking analytics by providing qualitative insights through reviews. Typical consumers include business analysts, product managers, and data scientists seeking to improve performance metrics. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure collaboration and feedback are streamlined, enhancing decision-making processes and fostering data-driven strategies.

post.summary: Submit a review for the contribution analysis of a specific resource.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit reviews for the contribution analysis associated with a specific resource identifier (RES-100045). It helps in gathering feedback and insights from users regarding the analysis provided.
